timeline.text_cn: 每装填一发弹药提供的治疗量从最大总生命值的2%提高至2.5%。

timeline.text_en: Max Life Heal per bullet reloaded increased to 2.5% (Up from 2%).

timeline.text_cn: 现在在“战术翻滚”期间会进入无敌状态。

lines_cn: 被替换为“穿障神枪”：“神射手”的子弹可以穿透屏障。

timeline.text_en: Now grants Invincibility during Combat Roll.
Every Final Blow earned via Deadeye grants 1 additional max ammo for the round, up to a cap of 18 max ammo.
Replaced with True Shot - Deadeye's bullets pierce barriers.

timeline.text_cn: 绝处逢生——次级威能 每秒治疗量从30点提高至40点。
每秒治疗量从30点提高至40点。

每装填或恢复一发弹药，治疗2%总生命值。
将[连射]变为技能：发射一次能贯穿的“维和者”射击，能在2.5秒内造成50点额外伤害。使用技能或装置时重置冷却时间。

lines_en: Combat Roll heals 15 health for each bullet reloaded.

timeline.text_cn: （新）“闪光弹”击中目标时，“连射”的散布降低25%，持续2秒。
最近受到“闪光弹”伤害（2秒内）的敌人被“维和者”击中时，“闪光弹”的冷却时间缩短0.5秒。

（新）敌人生命值低于30%时，其头部会被标记。被标记的头部判定区域更大，且对标记敌人造成暴击时具有50%武器生命汲取。

“闪光弹”击中或造成暴击会使“战术翻滚”的冷却时间缩短2秒。

已移除，并整合进“总有午时……”。
消灭最近受过“闪光弹”伤害的敌人会获得20%终极技能充能。使用“神射手”时，获得100点过量生命值，移动速度加快25%。

已移除，并转化为一件英雄物品（蛇噬之毒）。
使用“神射手”时，视线里的所有敌人减速20%，持续2.5秒。
（新）使用“战术翻滚”每装填一发弹药，治疗最大总生命值的2.5%。
现在每装填一发弹药会治疗最大总生命值的一定百分比，而不是一个固定数值。
在对抗输出职责的敌人时，武器生命汲取提高20%。
将条件效果和主效果做了对换。

timeline.text_en: (New) Flashbang hits reduce Fan the Hammer's spread by 25% for 2s.
Peacekeeper hits against enemies recently damaged by Flashbang (within 2s) reduce its cooldown by 0.5s.
Peacekeeper hits grant 1% Move Speed for 5s, stacking up to 15 times. At Max Stacks, gain 10% Damage Reduction.

(New) Flashbang becomes magnetic and has 50% increased throw distance.
Flashbang hits and Critical Hits reduce Combat Roll's cooldown by 2s.
Deadeye eliminations grant 25% Ultimate Charge each. If you get no eliminations with Deadeye, refund 33% Ultimate Charge.
Removed and combined into It's 12 O'Clock Somewhere.
Eliminating an enemy recently damaged by Flashbang grants 20% Ultimate Charge. While using Deadeye, gain 100 Overhealth and 25% Move Speed.
Removed and combined with Easy Rider.
Removed and converted to a Hero Item (Snakebite).

(New) - Heal 2.5% of your Max Life for each Ammo loaded using Combat Roll.
Now heals a percentage of your Max Life per ammo instead of a flat number.
Gain 20% Weapon Lifesteal against enemies in the Damage role.
Swapped the conditional stat and main stat.
Hinder duration increased from 0.9 to 1.2 seconds
